pull.title: KAFKA-18574: Sort quarantined test list by class_name and test_name
pull.body:
### Motivation

  The quarantined test list in the GitHub Actions JUnit summary report was not sorted, making it harder to locate
  specific tests in the output.

  ### Changes

  Sort the `quarantined_table` by `class_name` and `test_name` before rendering it in the Markdown summary. The list
  contains tuples of `(simple_class_name, test_name)`, so a standard `.sort()` produces the correct ordering.

  ### Testing

  Added `test_junit.py` with two unit tests:
  - Verifies the raw list is unsorted before sorting (confirming the test data is valid)
  - Verifies the list is correctly sorted by class name then test name after calling `.sort()`

  ### Related

  https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-18574

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>, ryanwaha (github:ryanwaha)

@kirktrue  `test_junit.py` doesn't run automatically in CI right now.
  A few options for how to proceed:

  **Option A — Wire it up in CI**

  Add `pytest~=8.0` to `requirements.txt` and a step in the `validate` job in `build.yml`:

  - name: Run Python script tests

issue.title: KAFKA-18574: Sort test tables in JUnit summary by class and test name

repository.name: kafka
repository.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue.body:
The test tables in the JUnit job summary (Failed, Flaky, Skipped,
Quarantined and New) are printed in the order the reports are parsed,
which follows the filesystem order of `glob()` and is not stable across
environments. This sorts each table by class name and test name before
rendering.

This is a continuation of #21786, which was closed as stale.

Co-authored-by: Zhekai Chen <wrmxs227@gmail.com>

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>
